name: @nodetool-ai/mediagen-nodes
description: MediaGen channel nodes (zhipu, agnes, cloudflare, siliconflow, hfspaces, pixverse, gemini) for NodeTool — manifest-driven factory with per-channel adapters

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/build-typescript-workspace.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const entries=[]; for (const dir of fs.readdirSync('src/channels',{withFileTypes:true})) { if (dir.isDirectory()) entries.push(...JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/channels/'+dir.name+'/manifest.json','utf8'))); } fs.writeFileSync('dist/mediagen-manifest.json', JSON.stringify(entries, null, 2));"
